newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Gold, MRC plan merger.
newsitem.headline: Australian Gold, MRC plan merger.

text.p: Australian Gold Development said on Thursday it and Mineral Resources Corporation had agreed to a proposal to merge the two companies.

Australian Gold Development (AGD) said directors of both companies had concluded that the merger represented the most efficient and logical means of maximising the potential of AGD's mining and exploration projects.
Mineral Resources Corp (MRC) is the largest single shareholder in AGD holding about 18 percent of the 41.7 million ordinary shares on issue.
The proposed terms of the merger were one MRC share for every 14 AGD shares held and one MRC share for every 25 AGD options held.
Proportional terms would be offered in respect of the preference shares and partly paid shares.
If the schemes were implemented, AGD would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Toronto-listed MRC, which planned to apply for listing on the Australian Stock Exchange.
AGD shares were 0.3 cents firmer at 5.5 cents at 4.00 p.m. (0600 GTM) on Thursday, valuing the company at A$2.2 million.
